Name: Onan
Summary: Onan was the second son of Judah by the daughter of Shuah, given to Tamar after his brother Er died.
KeyStory: Onan refused to raise up children for his brother, and the LORD put him to death as well.
RelatedPeople: Judah; Tamar; Er; Shelah, Son of Judah
LifeLesson: Selfishness that withholds what is owed to others is sin, not shrewdness.
